florence.description: Cite: Bertini, Galas, Luchinat, Parigi, J. Magn. Reson. Ser. A 113, 151 (1995); for 2 <= FLAG < 3 (modified model) also J. Chem. Phys. 111, 5795 (1999) and Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 3, 4907 (2001). TAUDELTA = 2 (the previous fixed value): DELTA2 is the zero-field splitting squared, with electron relaxation modulated by TAUVM; any other value: DELTA2 is taken directly as the electron relaxation time tauS0.

florenceLS.description: Florence R1 with Lipari-Szabo local motion, SLS = order parameter S (not S^2): the paramagnetic rate is SLS^2 R1M(TAURM) + (1-SLS^2) R1M(TAURM*TAULM/(TAURM+TAULM)), then exchange with TAUMM, then the outer sphere (independent of TAURM). index 1, 2, 3 = dipolar, contact, cross part of the exchange-limited inner sphere, 4 = outer sphere, other = total; 1..4 add up to the total, so FlorenceLS(1,...)\+FlorenceLS(2,...)\+FlorenceLS(3,...)\+FlorenceLS(4,...) plots the contributions. The pieces of one point share one evaluation (two Florence runs, one when SLS is 0 or 1). R1 only (IREL = 1), S4M = 0. Note the argument order (CONCM, RKM, DM, DDM, ACONTM, AMOLFRAM) differs from FlorenceN. Cite: Bertini, Galas, Luchinat, Parigi, J. Magn. Reson. Ser. A 113, 151 (1995); for 2 <= FLAG < 3 (modified model) also J. Chem. Phys. 111, 5795 (1999) and Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 3, 4907 (2001); Lipari, Szabo, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 104, 4546 (1982). TAUDELTA as in FlorenceN.
